segments.name: Bitcoin Mining Business
segments.description: Mines Bitcoin using its own mining machines, mining sites and purchased hashrate, and holds and sells the Bitcoin it mines.
segments.evidence: In 2024, following the commencement of the Bitcoin mining business, the CODM began to evaluate the performance of the overall business based on two distinct reportable segments

segments.name: International Automobile Trading Business
segments.description: Trades automobiles internationally, mainly through used car trading operations conducted from outside the PRC-based business it sold.
segments.evidence: Accordingly, the Company now reports segment financial information based on two reportable segments: (i) Bitcoin Mining Business and (ii) International Automobile Trading Business

revenueModel.text: Customers pay the company for Bitcoin it mines and for automobiles it trades across international markets.

changes.text: In 2025 the company divested its PRC business of loan facilitations, aftermarket services, financing leasing and domestic automobile trading, reported as discontinued operations.
changes.evidence: On May 27, 2025, the Company finalized the divestment of all its business related to loan facilitations, aftermarket services, financing leasing services, domestic automotible trading and related services in the PRC

changes.text: In 2024 the company began Bitcoin mining and added a second reportable segment beside Automobile and Related Business.
changes.evidence: In 2024, following the commencement of the Bitcoin mining business, the CODM began to evaluate the performance of the overall business based on two distinct reportable segments

changes.text: In 2025 the automobile segment was narrowed to the International Automobile Trading Business that started that year.
changes.evidence: In 2025, the CODM ceased reviewing the performance of Automobile and Related Business other than the International Automobile Trading Business, which commenced in the second quarter of fiscal year 2025.
